```bash
npx create-react-app . --template typescript

```bash

```typescript
export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SurveyRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  location: {
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
  };
  photoData: string;
  grassSpecs: GrassSpec[];
  markerPoints: MarkerPoint[];
  gridEnabled: boolean;
}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

import { create } from 'zustand';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

import { create } from 'zustand';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;

}));

export interface GrassSpec {

  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;

}

}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/types/index.ts
```typescript
export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SurveyRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  location: {

  };

  gridEnabled: boolean;
}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

```typescript
export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SurveyRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  location: {
    latitude: number;

  };

}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/types/index.ts
```typescript
export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SurveyRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  location: {
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
  };
  photoData: string;
  grassSpecs: GrassSpec[];
  markerPoints: MarkerPoint[];
  gridEnabled: boolean;
}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/types/index.ts
```typescript
export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SurveyRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  location: {
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
  };

}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;

}

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;

}

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

export interface GrassSpec {

  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

export interface GrassSpec {

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

  addRecord: (record) =>

}));

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({

  addRecord: (record) =>

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};

```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/types/index.ts
```typescript
export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SurveyRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  location: {
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
  };
  photoData: string;
  grassSpecs: GrassSpec[];
  markerPoints: MarkerPoint[];
  gridEnabled: boolean;
}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

        latitude: 36.0,

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {

```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/pages/Home.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-black">
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-green-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <CameraIcon size={16}# 草地样方调查 - 完整项目创建指南

export interface GrassSpec {

}

```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-black">
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-green-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <CameraIcon size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-lg">草地样方调查</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/history')}
          className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors"
        >
          <History size={24} />
        </button# 草地样方调查 - 完整项目创建指南

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-black">
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-green-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <CameraIcon size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-lg">草地样方调查</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/history')}
          className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors"
        >
          <History size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 relative">
        <Camera onCapture={handleCapture} />
        
        <div className="absolute top-1/2# 草地样方调查 - 完整项目创建指南

export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;

  color: string;
}

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-black">
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-green-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <CameraIcon size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-lg">草地样方调查</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/history')}
          className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors"
        >
          <History size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 relative">
        <Camera onCapture={handleCapture} />
        
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none z-20">

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-black">
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-green-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <CameraIcon size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-lg">草地样方调查</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/history')}
          className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors"
        >
          <History size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 relative">
        <Camera onCapture={handleCapture} />
        
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none z-20">
          <div 
            className="relative border-3 border-orange-400"
            style={{ width: 'min(80vw, 350px)', height: 'min(80vw, 350px)' }}
          >
            <div className="absolute -top-8 left-0 right-0 text-center">
              <span className="bg-orange-500 text-white# 草地样方调查 - 完整项目创建指南

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-black">
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-green-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <CameraIcon size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-lg">草地样方调查</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/history')}
          className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors"
        >
          <History size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 relative">
        <Camera onCapture={handleCapture} />
        
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none z-20">
          <div 
            className="relative border-3 border-orange-400"
            style={{ width: 'min(80vw, 350px)', height: 'min(80vw, 350px)' }}
          >
            <div className="absolute -top-8 left-0 right-0 text-center">
              <span className="bg-orange-500 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold">1m × 1m 样方框</span>
            </div>

            {gridEnabled && (
              <div className# 草地样方调查 - 完整项目创建指南

在电脑上创建文件夹：`草地样方工具`

### 1.2 初始化项目
打开命令行（CMD/终端），进入文件夹执行：

```bash
npx create-react-app . --template typescript
```

### 1.3 安装依赖
```bash
npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/android lucide-react zustand
npm install -D @capacitor/cli
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p
```

### 📄 src/types/index.ts
```typescript
export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SurveyRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  location: {
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
  };
  photoData: string;
  grassSpecs: GrassSpec[];
  markerPoints: MarkerPoint[];
  gridEnabled: boolean;
}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

  return (

## 📱 第4步：创建页面组件

### 📄 src/pages/Home.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-black">
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-green-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <CameraIcon size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-lg">草地样方调查</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/history')}
          className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors"
        >
          <History size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 relative">
        <Camera onCapture={handleCapture} />
        
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none z-20">
          <div 
            className="relative border-3 border-orange-400"
            style={{ width: 'min(80vw, 350px)', height: 'min(80vw, 350px)' }}
          >
            <div className="absolute -top-8 left-0 right-0 text-center">
              <span className="bg-orange-500 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold">1m × 1m 样方框</span>
            </div>

            {gridEnabled && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 grid grid-cols-10 grid-rows-10">
                {Array.from({ length: 100 }).map((_, i) => (

### 1.2 初始化项目
打开命令行（CMD/终端），进入文件夹执行：

```bash
npx create-react-app . --template typescript
```

### 1.3 安装依赖
```bash
npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/android lucide-react zustand
npm install -D @capacitor/cli
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p
```

### 📄 src/types/index.ts
```typescript
export interface GrassSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coverage: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface MarkerPoint {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface SurveyRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  location: {
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
  };
  photoData: string;
  grassSpecs: GrassSpec[];
  markerPoints: MarkerPoint[];
  gridEnabled: boolean;
}
```

### 📄 src/store/index.ts
```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

## 📱 第4步：创建页面组件

### 📄 src/pages/Home.tsx
```tsx
import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen bg-black">
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-green-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <CameraIcon size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-lg">草地样方调查</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/history')}
          className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors"
        >
          <History size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 relative">
        <Camera onCapture={handleCapture} />
        
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none z-20">
          <div 
            className="relative border-3 border-orange-400"
            style={{ width: 'min(80vw, 350px)', height: 'min(80vw, 350px)' }}
          >
            <div className="absolute -top-8 left-0 right-0 text-center">
              <span className="bg-orange-500 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold">1m × 1m 样方框</span>
            </div>

            {gridEnabled && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 grid grid-cols-10 grid-rows-10">
                {Array.from({ length: 100 }).map((_, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="border border-white/30" />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { SurveyRecord } from '../types';

interface AppStore {
  records: SurveyRecord[];
  addRecord: (record: SurveyRecord) => void;
  deleteRecord: (id: string) => void;
}

export const useAppStore = create<AppStore>((set) => ({
  records: [],
  addRecord: (record) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: [record, ...state.records] })),
  deleteRecord: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ records: state.records.filter((r) => r.id !== id) })),
}));
```

### 📄 src/utils/analysis.ts
```typescript
import { GrassSpec } from '../types';

export const analyzeGrass = (imageData: string): GrassSpec[] => {
  const grassNames = ['羊草', '针茅', '冰草', '披碱草', '早熟禾', '其他'];
  const colors = [
    '#4CAF50',
    '#8BC34A',
    '#CDDC39',
    '#FFC107',
    '#00BCD4',
    '#9E9E9E',
  ];

  let remaining = 100;
  const result: GrassSpec[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < grassNames.length; i++) {
    const name = grassNames[i];
    const isLast = i === grassNames.length - 1;
    
    let coverage;
    if (isLast) {
      coverage = remaining;
    } else {
      coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(remaining, 50));
      if (coverage < 5) coverage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20);
    }
    
    remaining -= coverage;
    if (coverage > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: `grass-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        name,
        coverage,
        color: colors[i],
      });
    }
  }
  
  return result.sort((a, b) => b.coverage - a.coverage);
};
```

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Camera as CameraIcon, Grid3X3, XSquare, History, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Camera } from '../components/Camera';
import { useAppStore } from '../store';
import { SurveyRecord, MarkerPoint } from '../types';
import { analyzeGrass } from '../utils/analysis';

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [gridEnabled, setGridEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [markers, setMarkers] = useState<MarkerPoint[]>([]);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{lat: number; lng: number} | null>(null);
  const { addRecord } = useAppStore();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const handleCapture = useCallback(async (photoData: string) => {
    const grassSpecs = analyzeGrass(photoData);
    
    const record: SurveyRecord = {

      timestamp: Date.now(),
      location: location ? {
        latitude: location.lat,
        longitude: location.lng,
      } : {
        latitude: 36.0,
        longitude: 106.0,
      },
      photoData,
      grassSpecs,
      markerPoints: markers,
      gridEnabled,
    };
    
    addRecord(record);
    navigate('/result', { state: { record } });
  }, [markers, gridEnabled, location, addRecord, navigate]);

  const handleCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!gridEnabled) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    
    setMarkers([
      ...markers,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        x: (x / rect.width) * 100,
        y: (y / rect.height) * 100,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      },
    ]);
  };

  const clearMarkers = () => setMarkers([]);

  return (

      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-900 text-white z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

            <CameraIcon size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-lg">草地样方调查</span>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/history')}
          className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-full transition-colors"
        >
          <History size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 relative">
        <Camera onCapture={handleCapture} />
        
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none z-20">
          <div 
            className="relative border-3 border-orange-400"
            style={{ width: 'min(80vw, 350px)', height: 'min(80vw, 350px)' }}
          >
            <div className="absolute -top-8 left-0 right-0 text-center">
              <span className="bg-orange-500 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold">1m × 1m 样方框</span>
            </div>

            {gridEnabled && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 grid grid-cols-10 grid-rows-10">
                {Array.from({ length: 100 }).map((_, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="border border-white/30" />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

              ref={canvasRef}
              className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-auto"
